Search4 is a renowned specialist national recruiter, dedicated to matching top talent with leading organisations within the Construction, IT and Public Sectors. We can offer:
A leadership team with extensive experience in high-performing teams
A training & development program that elevates our experienced consultants and develops future leaders.
Systems that are ahead of industry standards
A database of over 700,000 candidates 
Work-life balance and flexibility

Drive and passion to succeed and to be a good role model to our Associate Consultants.
A forward thinker with the ability to problem-solve and meet the challenges we face. 
Minimum 2 years of agency recruitment experience in a 360 position
Excellent relationship-building and communication skills.

Inclusive benefits are:
High commission percentages (no changing goalposts)
Flexible hours and a 35-hour working week with a strong emphasis on work-life balance including work from home
25 days annual leave (Christmas closure period covered bySearch4)

4 dedicated training and VC Rooms.

The Queen’s Club


Sydney CBD, NSW
Full-time
$80,000 – $100,000 per year + Super


About Us The Queen’s Club is one of Australia’s oldest and most prestigious private members clubs, located in the heart of Sydney CBD. We provide exceptional dining, accommodation and event experiences to our members and guests and pride ourselves on delivering outstanding customer service.
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Restaurant Manager to lead our Food & Beverage operations.

About the Role Reporting to the CEO, you will oversee the daily operation of the Club’s restaurant, bar and member dining services while leading a professional front-of-house team.

Key Responsibilities
Manage the day-to-day restaurant and bar operations.
Deliver exceptional member and guest service.
Lead, coach and develop the front-of-house team.
Prepare staff rosters and manage labour costs.
Coordinate restaurant bookings, functions and special events.
Work closely with the Executive Chef to maintain high food and service standards.
Monitor stock ordering, inventory control and monthly stocktakes.
Ensure compliance with Food Safety, RSA and WHS requirements.
Manage POS systems, cash handling and end-of-day reconciliation.
Handle member enquiries and resolve issues professionally.
Monitor budgets and contribute to achieving financial targets.

About You To be successful, you will have:
Minimum 2 years’ relevant experience.
Strong leadership and communication skills.
Experience in restaurant, hotel or club operations.
Knowledge of food, wine and beverage service.
Experience with rostering, budgeting and stock control.
Excellent presentation and customer service skills.

Why Join The Queen’s Club?
Work for one of Sydney’s most respected private clubs.
Competitive salary package.
Career development opportunities.
Supportive management team.
Staff meals provided while on duty.
CBD location close to public transport.
Stable, full-time position with an established organisation.


Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Happysoul Catering Pty Ltd is looking for Head Chef to join our Kitchen Team. HAPPYSOUL CATERING PTY. LTD is hospitality company based in Australia running different venues across Regional NSW and Sydney NSW .Happysoul Catering Group is described as a fast-growing, supportive employer. HAPPYSOUL CATERING PTY is looking for Skilled Head Chefs to join our dedicated kitchen team to run our outlets located within Narrabri Golf Club at 116 Gibbons Street Narrabri NSW 2390 Australia

As a Head Chef in our Happysoul Catering Group you’ll oversee all aspects of kitchen operations, ensuring creativity, consistency, and quality across every service. You’ll lead by example, from hands-on cooking to mentoring your team and maintaining strong cost and quality controls.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead daily kitchen operations, ensuring smooth service, staff supervision, and consistent quality.

- Coordinating daily service and kitchen operation

- Preparing and cooking food

- Menu development and daily specials

- Managing stock control, ordering and food costing

- Ensure quality and presentation of all foods.

- Training and developing kitchen staff.

- Manage staff rosters to ensure efficient coverage and optimal workflow.

- Receiving & storing food stocks, kitchen supplies and equipment

- Advising on cooking procedures and demonstrating techniques

- Discussing food preparation issues with senior management

- Maintaining quality, preparation and presentation of dishes quality

- Implementing systems & procedures

- Implement, explain and enforcing hygiene regulations & secure workplace.

- Select and train staff.

- Freeze and preserve foods..

Key Requirement

   - Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery & Diploma Level
   -  Minimum 1 – 2 years experience as a Chef in a similar role
    - Flexible availability, including weekends and evenings.
    - Positive attitude and strong team spirit
    - Honest, humble, and results-driven

Please include a current resume and supporting documents to your application. Email your CV to us

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Looking for your next mining role? Join a leading operation as a Communications Technician   Your New Company    Join a highly respected and long standing mining operation in North West Queensland. With a strong safety culture, modern infrastructure, and a collaborative team environment, this is an excellent opportunity to secure a long-term role supporting critical communications systems on site.        Your New Role    We are seeking an experienced Radio Technician / Communications Technician to join a site-based mining operation on a 7/7 or 8/6 roster, FIFO from Townsville or Cairns.    This hands-on role will see you responsible for maintaining and improving the site's communications infrastructure, ensuring reliable connectivity across mining operations.        Key Responsibilities   
 
 Install, maintain, and support radio and communications systems 
 Maintain and troubleshoot UHF/VHF radio networks 
 Support leaky feeder communication systems 
 Perform fault finding, repairs, and system optimisation 
 Maintain CCTV and telephony (VoIP) systems 
 Deliver infrastructure upgrades and commissioning activities 
 Maintain accurate documentation and system records 
 Respond to incidents and escalations as required 
 Work closely with IT and operational teams to ensure seamless connectivity across site 
 
     What You'll Need to Succeed   
 
 Trade qualification or demonstrated experience in Radio Communications, Telecommunications, Electronics, ICT, or similar 
 Current Australian Driver's Licence 
 Experience working with communications infrastructure in an industrial, mining, or commercial environment 
 Strong fault-finding and troubleshooting skills 
 
     Highly regarded:   
 
 UHF/VHF radio systems experience 
 Leaky feeder systems 
 CCTV systems 
 Telephony and VoIP systems 
 Mining or remote-site experience 
 
     What's on Offer   
 
 FIFO from Townsville or Cairns 
 7/7 or 8/6 roster 
 $55-$68 per hour + super (depending on experience) 
 Long-term opportunity with a reputable mining operation 
 Exposure to a broad range of communications technologies 
 Supportive and experienced team environment 
 
     What You Need to Do Now    If you're interested in this role, click 'Apply Now' to submit your updated CV, or contact our office directly on 07 4749 8399 or via email at mtisa@hays.com.au.    Please  click here  to apply.
